I am a PhD student in Criminology & Criminal Justice at the University of Texas at Dallas. My research focuses on white-collar crime, crime prevention, human rights, and law enforcement.

## Education

- Ph.D. in Criminology & Criminal Justice, University of Texas at Dallas (in progress)
- M.S. in Criminology, University of Texas at Dallas
- Bachelor of Law (LL.B.), Universidade Federal do Paraná (UFPR), Brazil

## Research Interests

- White-collar crime
- Crime prevention
- Human rights
- Law enforcement
